key_insight: For the scheduling instance and initialization studied, an entanglement-free VQA produced feasible schedules without gains from entangling circuits.
engineering_relevance: Day-by-day decomposition and logarithmic binary encoding kept scheduling batches within 30 qubits while accounting for worker capacities, skills, priorities, deadlines, and calendar stability.
method: Formulate multi-skill project scheduling as a QUBO and propagate remaining workload between daily batches.
Compare linear and brick-wall entangling ansätze with an entanglement-free reference using equal parameter counts.
Train each configuration with COBYLA and Adam using SPSA gradient estimates.
evidence_signal: In simulation, the entanglement-free reference yielded feasible schedules with both optimizers; with COBYLA, it came closest to the required workload at a fraction of the entangled circuits’ simulation cost.
watch_item: Results are limited to the instance and initialization studied; broader performance and robustness on noisy quantum hardware remain unestablished.
paper_title: A Variational Quantum Algorithm for Multi-Skill Project Scheduling
